acceptanceCriteria: Canonical close decisions are validated before any close receipt is written and invalid decision tokens fail with the allowed vocabulary.
The two documentation gates use one identity-bound promotion execution per request; documentation acceptance consumes that result without repeating the scan.

A failed documentation gate reports the gate id, command, exit status, diagnostic path, and the first structured failure details including file, field, expected value, and actual value when available.
WI-812 immutable bytes remain unchanged and its recovery relationship is explicit and repository-bound.
Focused and workspace tests cover normal close, superseded or failed-delivery close semantics, historical recovery, documentation gate failure diagnostics, and no-duplicate execution.
Existing CLI close and multilingual outcome tests use the canonical decision vocabulary and remain green.
A non-canonical close token is rejected without creating a receipt while canonical approved close remains compatible across CLI paths.
goal: Restore main quality convergence after v0.2.91 by preserving WI-812 history through successor recovery, validating canonical close decisions, and reusing one identity-bound documentation promotion result instead of repeating the same scan.
intent: Make documentation gate failures directly diagnosable and execute promotion once per request while preventing future close receipts with non-canonical decision tokens.
outOfScope: rewriting WI-812 historical Contract archive evidence or close bytes
